summary: Validates execution forking, branch isolation, time-travel replay, and deterministic reconstruction.

validations.name: fork_creation
validations.description: fork_execution creates independent branch with new execution_id
validations.detail: Branch starts with FORK_CREATED event, prefix events re-sequenced under new ID

validations.name: branch_isolation
validations.description: Two forks from same point have independent branch_ids and execution_ids

validations.name: time_travel_rewind
validations.description: rewind_to_sequence returns correct prefix of event stream

validations.name: state_reconstruction
validations.description: reconstruct_state_at rebuilds ExecutionState at any sequence point
validations.detail: State at seq=2 shows 1 completed stage; state at seq=5 shows COMPLETED status

validations.name: timeline_diff
validations.detail: Identical branches → identical=True; divergent branches → diffs list

validations.name: mergeability_check
validations.description: mergeable returns (True, reason) for compatible branches
validations.detail: Same ancestor + same fork point + same state → mergeable

validations.name: replay_from_events
validations.description: replay_from_events reconstructs correct timeline from event stream
validations.detail: Replayed stages match original pipeline execution
